content: अजकावः, -वम् .²1 Śivaʼs bow. .²2 [अजकं छागं वाति प्रीणाति; वा-क] <ab>N.</ab> of the tree वर्वरी (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>तिळवण</ns>) of which goats are said to be very fond. .²3 [अजका अजागलस्तन इव वाति प्रकाशते वा-क] A sacrificial vessel of wood (of the form of अजागल) dedicated to Mitra and Varuṇa .({@-वम्@} in this sense) मैत्रावरुणपात्रम् .²4 A disease of the pupil of the eye = अजकाजात <ab>q. v.</ab> .²5 A venomous kind of vermin Cantipede or scorpion (अजका रोगविशेषः, तद्विषम्).
